decisions.rationale: ButtonStyle cannot express a transform, so every button-based control would need its own wrapper; and a chip lifting out of a recessed surfaceSunken track contradicts itself. All lifts (nav tab 1px, GWCard 2px) were removed on purpose.

decisions.decision: OverviewDashboardView (wallet + processing) stays top-left at every width
decisions.rationale: Confirmed by Jakub after this session moved it once, having misread a confirmation of the current state as a request to change it. Reverted.

decisions.decision: Sketch 038 variant A2 (bottom-row swap for seam alignment) REJECTED after a live walk
decisions.rationale: 'nie jest lepszy' — aligned seams were not worth moving the chart off the left edge. The 40/60-then-60/40 zigzag is a sighted trade, not an oversight. Do not re-propose.

decisions.decision: Buy GNUS removed from the navbar
decisions.rationale: It was the only element forcing a hierarchy on that side; without it the cluster can read as one instrument. The /buy route still exists — the shortcut went, not the feature.

decisions.decision: Brand gradient paints the Connect field ONLY on the idle branch
decisions.rationale: A brand gradient says 'invitation'. It cannot say 'error' or 'wait'. Three of the four Connect branches are statuses, so they keep their status colour.

decisions.decision: brandCtaText shader lifted from transactions_slim_view.dart to GeniusWalletGradient
